info.title: API.SH: Bilibili
info.description: The Bilibili API from API.SH: public Bilibili data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Search Bilibili videos (50 pages of 20): title, description, cover, duration, publish date, author, category, tags and stats (views, danmaku, favorites, replies, likes); `pubtime_begin` / `pubtime_end` limit videos to a publish-date range. `search_type` searches users (name, followers, videos, level, recent uploads), anime or film and TV (title, kind, areas, styles, cast, episodes, score), articles or live rooms (title, area, viewers, streamer) instead; those responses carry `search_type` in place of `order` and `duration`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bilibili-search

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort: totalrank (relevance), click (views), pubdate (newest), dm (danmaku), stow (favorites), scores (comments).

parameters.name: search_type
parameters.description: What to search: video (default), bili_user, media_bangumi (anime), media_ft (film and TV), article, live_room.

parameters.name: pubtime_begin
parameters.description: Videos published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, China time).

parameters.name: pubtime_end
parameters.description: Videos published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, China time).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Bilibili video: title, description, cover, duration, publish date, category, copyright type, uploader, stats (views, danmaku, replies, favorites, coins, shares, likes, rank), parts (multi-part videos), resolution, subtitles, co-creators, honors and tags. `include` adds `related` (recommended videos with stats), `danmaku` (the on-screen comments: time in the video, mode, colour, send time and text), `online_count` (people watching now) and `chapters` (the uploader's chapter marks with start and end seconds).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bilibili-video

parameters.name: bvid
parameters.description: BV id, or pass aid (the av number) or url.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated extras: related, danmaku, online, chapters.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
All replies under one comment of a Bilibili video, oldest first, up to 20 per page: text, date, likes, IP location, pictures, mentions and author, plus the comment itself and the total reply count. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (null on the last page). Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bilibili-video-comment-replies

parameters.name: bvid
parameters.description: BV id, av number (aid) or a bilibili.com/video link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The comments on a Bilibili video, hot or newest first, 20 per page: text, date, likes, reply count, IP location, pictures, emotes, mentions, whether the uploader liked or replied, the author (mid, name, avatar, level, VIP, verification) and the first replies of each comment; the pinned comments come with the first page. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page (null on the last). Use /bilibili/v1/video/comment/replies for all replies under a comment. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bilibili-video-comments

parameters.name: bvid
parameters.description: BV id, av number (aid) or a bilibili.com/video link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: hot (most liked and replied) or newest.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
